test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Eight people P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a square table for dinner in such a way that 4 persons are sitting at the four corners and 4 persons are sitting at the mid-position on the four sides. All of them are facing the centre of the square. S sits to the immediate left of U. U sits to the immediate left of T. T sits at one of the mid-positions of the sides. R sits third to the right of U. P is an immediate neighbour of both V and R. W is not an immediate neighbour of T.

Who among the following is sitting at one of the corners?
solution: Given that:- • T sits at one of the mid-positions of the sides. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af80c4c2d0ca9646bf6bbe2aeff38283bc2f8831376dc901891d21c109070010.png] • S sits to the immediate left of U. • U sits to the immediate left of T.
